Committee: Transportation and Energy
Sponsor: Allen
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/03/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 273 as introduced authorizes the establishment of joint road improvement authorities and provides for the powers of authorities. The bill provides that: (1) any bonds, and the income from bonds, by these authorities are exempted from state income tax; (2) all property of the authority are exempt from all taxation; and (3) exempts road projects of the authority from sales and use, and any other similar excise taxes.
This bill could reduce potential tax receipts to the State General Fund, the Education Trust Fund, and local government funds of the affected counties and municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number and activities of authorities created pursuant to this bill by allowing these authorities to be exempt from certain taxes and fees.
Gerald H. Allen, Chair Person
Transportation and Energy
